hotels.title: Tranquil Fiji Coral Coast Villa Hideaway with Private Beach
hotels.description: Serenity is on the menu at the oceanfront Tambua Sands Beach Resort, a pocket of paradise along the Coral Coast. Between moments spent sprawled on the private beach or splashing in the ocean, you can take advantage of the resort's exceptional facilities. Lunch and dinner are a casual affair at Tambua Sands Restaurant, where fresh seafood, traditional Fijian dishes and an extensive drinks list are perfectly accompanied by the ocean backdrop. Cool off in the vast freshwater pool, sip tropical cocktails on a sun lounger or try your hand at beach volleyball. When it's time to shake things up, nearby you can discover walking trails, sand dunes, adventure parks and a nine-hole golf course. If it's ocean magic you're after, there's snorkelling, canoeing and kayaking available. Access to the fitness centre and spa services at neighbouring resorts can be arranged, so you can enjoy the perfect balance of barefoot bliss and luxury amenities.

hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Family-Friendly Escape with Private Beach & Kids Club
hotels.description: Soak up the sun, escape the crowds and set your watch to island time on Fiji's Coral Coast at The Naviti Resort - a beachfront paradise perfect for rest and relaxation. Nestled amid tropical gardens, with a private stretch of sugar-fine sand, The Naviti Resort’s unbeatable location will instantly make you forget the outside world. Spread across 38 acres of tropical palms and just under two hours from Nadi, this is a secluded sanctuary for the entire family. Facilities include an exceptional swimming pool, swim-up bar, four distinct food and drink outlets, the indulgent Joy Spa and a stunning nine-hole golf course. Find a sun-kissed patch of sand to relax on, cool off in the azure Fijian waters or explore the pristine Coral Coast shores by boat. Venture out of the fabulous resort to discover the secrets of the nearby Biausevu Waterfall and Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park, or take the whole family on an educational daytrip to the Kula WILD Adventure Park.
